fact_notes: Trailers first ran after the feature and moved before it by the 1930s (mentalfloss.com/article/83734; worldwidewords.org/qa-tra2.html).
First legal paid US TV ad: Bulova, 1 July 1941, WNBT New York, about 10 s (emmys.com; guinnessworldrecords.com).
'About three seconds' is industry guidance, not a platform rule.
